semiconductor_relevance: High — Sealink Corp. specializes in vacuum and pressure sealing solutions specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: Sealink Corp. is a leading manufacturer of advanced sealing solutions for semiconductor equipment, focusing on high-vacuum rotary shaft seals that replace traditional magnetic fluid seals. Their products are utilized in various processes such as CVD, ALD, and CMP, enhancing performance and reliability in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: R-axis rotary feed-through for diffusion furnaces
Custom sealing solutions for semiconductor equipment
Rotary unions for sputter metal deposition

regional_presence.Korea: Sealink Corp. is based in Korea and focuses on developing sealing solutions for the semiconductor industry.
